# `when`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

When `expr1` = true, returns `expr2`; else when `expr3` = true, returns `expr4`; else returns `expr5`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
CASE WHEN expr1 THEN expr2 [WHEN expr3 THEN expr4]* [ELSE expr5] END
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `conditional_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.1 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments |  |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- when, example 1
> SELECT CASE WHEN 1 > 0 THEN 1 WHEN 2 > 0 THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.2 END;
1.0
```

```sql
-- when, example 2
> SELECT CASE WHEN 1 < 0 THEN 1 WHEN 2 > 0 THEN 2.0 ELSE 1.2 END;
2.0
```

```sql
-- when, example 3
> SELECT CASE WHEN 1 < 0 THEN 1 WHEN 2 < 0 THEN 2.0 END;
NULL
```
